service.runtime.roots.text.1: Installed payload versions, including boot-state.json and manifest-freshness.json; the fixed boot.mjs derives this location from dataDir.
service.runtime.roots.text.2: Logs in <day>.jsonl, continuous across generations; the fixed desktop launcher uses this location for “Open log directory”.
service.runtime.roots.text.3: Data generations, one directory per generation: <seq>/ (incomplete: <seq>.partial/). Selection is defined in runtime/generations.ts.
service.runtime.roots.text.4: User configuration: settings, subscriptions, connections and targets.
service.runtime.roots.text.5: Master key, password derivation salt, AI apiKey, source cookies and integration secrets.
service.runtime.roots.text.6: Application-managed runtime state: subscription state, roast drafts, live-cover rotation cursors and integration state. Losing it reduces functionality.
service.runtime.roots.text.7: Push history in <day>.jsonl (text is retained), repush originals in repush/<day>/, and retention.json recording the image/original cleanup boundary. Images live in images/; only references are stored here.
service.runtime.roots.text.8: Content-addressed image library: <sha256>.<ext>, shared by post images, covers, avatars, history snapshots and chat attachments.
service.runtime.roots.text.9: Posts in posts/, live sessions in live/, recording state in recording/, and follower time series in followers/; each uses one jsonl file per subscription.
service.runtime.roots.text.10: Uptime in hours.jsonl: one row records BN’s active minutes in a UTC clock hour, shared across the application. It is separate from statistics, ignores the statistics switch and is excluded from backups.
service.runtime.roots.text.12: Card skins in card/<id>/, dashboard skins in dashboard/<id>/, and dashboard/active.json.
service.runtime.roots.text.13: Resource library: card backgrounds in images/, fonts and their name index in fonts/.
service.runtime.roots.text.15: Installed extension packages, load failure records in load-state.json, and marketplace sources in .marketplace.json.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.1: User settings, subscriptions, connections and targets; this is configuration, not a cache.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.2: Master key, password salt, apiKey, cookies and integration secrets. Deleting them requires signing in and configuring credentials again.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.3: Application-managed runtime state (subscriptions, drafts, rotation cursors and integration state). Losing it reduces functionality; it is excluded from cleanup.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.4: Uptime is separate from statistics and unaffected by cleanup (ADR-0033, decision 3). Annual summaries still need it.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.5: Selected card and dashboard skins; delete them on their respective pages.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.6: Uploaded resources; delete them on the Resource Library page.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.7: Custom maid skills; delete them on the Resource Library page.
service.runtime.storage-usage.text.8: Installed extensions; uninstall them on the Extensions page.
